name: log-craft
description: Readable, good-looking CI job logs. Ships ci-log-design: audit a GitLab CI job log with a scoring script, judge it against a written taste guide, redesign it with a small text-art vocabulary (title rules, folded steps, failure cards, duration bars, tables, a verdict line), and apply it through a shared POSIX-sh and Node logging library with a demo, a canary job and a renderer for before/after proof.
